description: **First release: tree-sitter-typescript v0.23.2 in pure Go.** Translated from [tree-sitter-typescript v0.23.2](https://github.com/tree-sitter/tree-sitter-typescript/releases/tag/v0.23.2) (commit f975a621f4e7f532fe322e13c4f79495e0a7b2e7) with github.com/stricttools/wasm-to-go v0.5.0. Requires github.com/cgofree/tree-sitter v0.1.0. Parse trees and query captures are identical to a native C build of the same sources on 20152 inputs (typescript: 19702, 493 through the API; tsx: 450, 12 through the API).
